descriptionHtml:
Cream bouclé. A raised rim. The dog bed you stop hiding behind a chair.

Blea Tarn is a cream bouclé nest dog bed with a raised rim and a cushioned base, in Small 60 × 50cm, Medium 75 × 60cm and Large 90 × 70cm. The zipped cover washes at 30°C.

Two things pull against each other when you buy a dog bed. The one that suits your living room is thin and flat inside. The one with proper filling turns up in grey ripstop and gets pushed behind a chair.

This is cream bouclé, the texture of the armchair you keep looking at, with a rim a curled-up dog can hook a nose over.

What they get

  • Tactile cream bouclé: A finish that reads as furniture rather than pet equipment.
  • A raised rim all the way round: Somewhere to rest a chin and something to back into.
  • A cushioned nest base: Soft-filled rather than foam, so it yields under them instead of holding firm.
  • A zipped cover at 30°C: The outer layer lifts off, so cream is practical rather than brave.

Best for: Dogs who curl, and houses where the bed has to live in the good room. If yours needs firm support, read our memory foam beds instead.

Why it is worth the money

Small is £49, Medium £59 and Large £79. That buys bouclé you would accept on a chair, a filled rim right round, and a cover you can strip off one-handed. A bed you like the look of stays in the room where your dog wants to be. There are 100 nights to see whether they claim it.

The base here is cushioned fill, so a heavy dog with stiff back legs will press closer to the floor here than on foam.

Size and fit

SizeOutside (cm)
Small60 × 50
Medium75 × 60
Large90 × 70

These are outside measurements and the rim takes up part of them. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one to take.

Everyday care

Wash the removable cover at 30°C, following the sewn-in label. Air-dry fully before refitting.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

Which of the three sizes do I want?

Measure them curled up, read that against the outside figures, and size up if unsure.

How much is delivery, and how quickly does it arrive?

Free once your basket passes £40. Timings sit on the shipping page below.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Your options appear at checkout.

Is cream really sensible with a dog?

It is when the outer layer unzips and goes in at 30°C.

Will it suit an older dog who finds it hard to get up?

It is a soft-filled nest, yielding rather than supportive. Ask your vet about that.

Can I actually wash it?

The cover, yes. Dry it right through before refitting.

What if my dog just won't use it?

Send it back inside 100 nights. Collection costs you nothing.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.
